findings.claim: `build-manifest --check` can pass without running `agent-team-creator validate`, so the manifest validity requirement is not enforced in CI or fresh clones.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion: `.agent-team/team.json` SHALL pass `agent-team-creator validate`. The CLI code only calls `creatorValidate(manifest)` in `--check`, but if the creator CLI is unavailable it prints `agent-team-creator not found; validate skipped` unless `--require-validate` is supplied; `.github/workflows/agent-tooling.yml` runs `node scripts/agent-team/build-manifest.mjs --check` without `--require-validate`.
findings.suggested_fix: Make `--check` fail when `agent-team-creator` is unavailable, or update CI to install/provide the skill and run `node scripts/agent-team/build-manifest.mjs --check --require-validate`.
